column4: dialect-gated: single CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL gate, one skip. Regression test for cleat#2758: driver-level fault injection (real *net.OpError ECONNRESET, returned only after the real UPDATE executes server-side) reproduces the exact original bug (seq=2, err=nil) against the unfixed code. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestMSSQLStore_ConsumeSignalUnknownOutcomeAfterUpdate -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports 1.
